text:
Sam Patel: Quick sync note — QuillStream (prospect) wants a 2-week POC for their embed model `quill-embed-lite`. Goal: Hosted trial -> Catalog variant; option to migrate to Dedicated with BYOK and EU-only deployment. They also sent a partial security questionnaire and asked for a 1000 QPS cost sketch.

Maya Carter: Thanks Sam. Can someone run a lightweight compatibility probe on the sample bundle they dropped in sandbox? It's a 12MB tarball named quill-embed-lite.tgz.

Leo Kim: I grabbed the bundle. Short probe checklist: tokenizer format, emb dim, dtype, custom ops, and quant readiness. Running probe now.

Chen Wu: Note for catalog: we prefer namespaced variants `partner/quill-embed-lite` and suffixes for quantized/dedicated. Also check license (no GPL-incompatible clauses) before putting in catalog.

Leo Kim: Probe output (local): tokenizer = HF json (BPE), emb_dim = 1024, weights = fp32, forward uses standard matmul, no custom ops. Quant script runs: q4/q8 pipelines succeed but q4 too lossy on our eval; q8 acceptable.

Maya Carter: Great — what's perf look like?

Leo Kim: Microbench (synthetic 5k queries): fp32: p99 ~ 120ms, throughput ~320 qps/worker. q8: p99 ~ 72ms, throughput ~700 qps/worker. Accuracy delta (cosine) q8 vs fp32 ~0.9% absolute on their sample set.

Ops Team: High-level cost sketch for 1000 sustained QPS (monthly estimates): Hosted fp16 path: ~$0.0009/embed -> ~$78k/mo. Hosted q8: ~$0.00048/embed -> ~$42k/mo. Dedicated (1-2x V100/A10G equiv reserve depending on burst) -> ~$45k–$60k/mo incl infra. EU-only placement adds ~10% surcharge. Numbers depend on average payload size and P95 traffic.

Security Bot: From partial questionnaire: BYOK required for Dedicated, EU data residency, and they request SOC2 + pen-test summary. They provided a summary doc but not full reports. Also need their embedding retention policy. We'll need full questionnaire + NDA.

Chen Wu: I'll draft a one-page compatibility summary: kernel support, recommended variants (q8 as cost/latency sweet spot), risk: tokenizer migration friction low, license check needed. Can add a small badge: green=compatible, yellow=minor work, red=blocking.

Lara Gomez: I'll assemble the POC plan and slides with pricing lanes (Hosted fp16 / Hosted q8 / Dedicated). Suggest 2-week POC with sample test harness and 1 evaluation metric (cosine at fixed queries). Schedule a 30min handoff w/ QuillStream + eng next Tue if that works.

Maya Carter: I'll get NDA and full security questionnaire uploaded. Also confirm if they allow us to host quantized weights or if they prohibit transformed artifacts (legal question).

Sam Patel: They said in email they're OK with hosting but need license confirmation. I'll push for NDA signature today.

Ops Team: Reminder: if they want private audit logs and extended retention that will be an add-on priced separately. Also cross-region DR for EU+US will increase infra by ~18%.

Leo Kim: Plan: run their real sample set through fp32 and q8 variants and dump a small quality report for the deck. Will share numbers by EOD tomorrow.

Maya Carter: Thanks all — creating the calendar invite and will post the sandbox link + token once NDA is in place. :thumbsup:
